results.title: Zernio Review: A Fact Check of Its Biggest Marketing Claim
results.content:
It does not make your images. It is a pipe, and a well-built one. You bring the content, it handles the messy business of talking to fifteen different platform APIs so you never have to apply for TikTok developer access yourself.

That is a real problem worth solving. Anyone who has tried to get approved for a platform API directly knows the process is genuinely miserable.

### The Late and GetLate Rebrand

If you researched this category more than a few months ago you probably met this product under a different name. Zernio's own rebrand page confirms it: Late is now Zernio, same API, same team, same `/api/v1` endpoints, no breaking changes.

This matters when you are researching. Plenty of third-party pages about this product still file it under the old name. [...] So where does 1.5 come from? I genuinely do not know, and I am not going to invent a theory to fill the gap.

It does not appear in Blotato's documentation, and Zernio does not show its work. The same page separately claims Blotato's Starter plan caps you at 3 unique TikTok accounts per 24 hours, which would be a platform-level posting restriction rather than an API throughput number, but I could not verify that limit in Blotato's docs either.

What I can say with confidence is narrower and still damning: the number Zernio divides by does not match the documented figure, and it does not match the figure in Zernio's own table.

I am not going to tell you Zernio is a bad tool because of this. It is not. [...] Zernio delivers. It does not create. So the agent still needs somewhere to write the copy and something to make the image, and I am back to stitching services together in a conversation that should have been one instruction.

That is a preference, not a defect, and if you already have generation solved it is not a reason to avoid Zernio at all. But it is the specific thing that kept me from switching, and it is more useful to you than another paragraph about response times.

## What Zernio Actually Is

Zernio positions itself as "a developer-first REST API and hosted MCP server that lets apps and AI agents post, schedule, and analyze content across 16 social platforms plus 7 ad networks."

Read that again, because the important word is infrastructure. Zernio does not write your posts.
